Body.Content:
Journey Visualization brings live conversation data onto the map of your contact center configuration, so admins can see how conversations actually flow, not just how they were designed to flow. Admins can spot patterns across many conversations, then select any single conversation and follow its path step by step, from arrival through routing and queues to resolution.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/contact-center/administer/trace-conversations-with-journey-visualization

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
